detail.longDescription: I'm launching StarSkirmish, an arena for LLMs to create StarCraft: Brood War bots It draws on my previous work, LLM Skirmish, where LLMs were asked to write JavaScript strategies to compete in a Screeps like RTS. In StarSkirmish, LLMs get 1 hour of wall clock time to write the strongest StarCraft BW bots they can in C++. It is then evaluated against other LLMs' bots and established human written bots. All bot are BWAPI 4.4.0, played via OpenBW. All scored matches are Protoss vs Protoss only right now. GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 are functionally tied as the top 2 scoring StarSkirmish Bench LLMs. Most interestingly to me is StarSkirmish suggests a much more precipitous drop off in capability's once you go outside the OpenAI and Anthropic frontier, then many other public benchmarks would suggest.
